notes: Backbone comparison against metra_joint: same ICU cohort, same fusion, same optimiser, same augmentation, same cache. The only difference is image_encoder, which swaps the ImageNet ViT-B/16 for an ImageNet ResNet-18 (timm_resnet). Both project to the same 64-wide fusion, so the two runs are also parameter-matched; only the frozen features differ. Residual difference that cannot be removed: 50 image tokens (7x7 grid + summary) against 197 for ViT-B/16 at 224, which is inherent to a CNN grid versus a patch grid. Freezing here also pins BatchNorm to eval (TimmResNet.train), so this arm uses ImageNet normalisation statistics exactly like the ViT arm.
